title: 'Biologics' as soft-tissue drones in conscious craft

tellings.quote: So the biologics could be something like soft tissue drones.

plain: The beings said to be found with crashed craft, which people in this field call "biologics," might not be pilots at all but "something like soft tissue drones," living tools run by craft that are themselves conscious. Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot who says he flew a UFO retrieval mission, passes this idea on to Michels from a man he names only as Dave. If it were right, the bodies would be parts of the craft rather than the ones flying it.
